title: Invoices
description: e-Invoices and e-Archive invoices: drafts, validation, sending to the integrator, cancellation and returns.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view invoices.
empty_description: Create an invoice with "Issue invoice" on a rental or an account, or in bulk for selected rentals.
links_hint: The invoice only links these accruals; it posts no debt or revenue to the ledger.
attempts_hint: Every attempt with the integrator; an uncertain result is checked with a status query first.
ledger_note: Sending an invoice, or a failed send, never changes the ledger.
status_hint.failed: The send failed; fix it and retry.
hold.no_account: No e-invoice integration is connected; the send is waiting.
hold.adapter_unverified: The official integrator is not ready yet; the send is waiting.
hold.adapter_unavailable: The integrator is unavailable right now; the send is waiting.
bulk.title: Invoice the selected rentals
bulk.description: Rentals with uninvoiced accruals. One draft is made for each rental.
bulk.note: Drafts post nothing to the ledger; the action can be rolled back.
cancel.title: Cancel the invoice
cancel.description: The invoice is cancelled and its accruals can be invoiced again.
cancel.earsiv_description: The e-Archive invoice is cancelled at the integrator; its accruals can be invoiced again.
return.title: Issue a return invoice
return.description: A draft of type IADE is made for the whole invoice; its accruals are released.
card.title: Invoices
card.empty_description: Use "Issue invoice" to draft the uninvoiced accruals.
create.title: Issue invoice
create.description: Select the accruals to invoice. The draft posts nothing to the ledger.
create.empty_description: Every accrual is already linked to an invoice.
create.ledger_note: The invoice only links the selected accruals; it posts no debt or revenue.
detail.title: Invoice
draft.title: Edit draft
draft.description: Profile, date, note and receiver details.
draft.identity_hint: Leave empty to keep the stored number.
draft.profile_einvoice: The receiver is an e-invoice taxpayer: Basic or Commercial profile.
draft.profile_earsiv: The receiver is not an e-invoice taxpayer: e-Archive.
line.title: Edit line
line.exemption_hint: A 0% VAT rate needs a GİB exemption code (e.g. 351).
line.amount_note: The amount comes from the linked accrual and cannot change; VAT is split out of it.
preview.draft: Draft preview: no number or signature until finalized.
preview.stored: View of the document that was sent.
preview.unavailable: The preview could not be built.
problems.title: The document cannot be sent: {{count}} problem(s)
problems.hint: XSD and Schematron validation flagged these fields. Fix them and validate again.
problems.generic: The action could not be completed.
problems.already_invoiced: One of the items is already linked to another invoice.
problems.dependency_pending: The official integrator is not ready yet.
problems.unverified: The previous send's result is uncertain; its status must be checked first.
problems.use_return: An issued e-invoice cannot be cancelled; issue a return invoice.
problems.not_returnable: A return invoice cannot be issued for this invoice.
problems.not_draft: The invoice is no longer a draft.
problems.pdf_unavailable: The PDF cannot be built right now.
toast.finalized: Invoice finalized and queued for sending.
toast.rerouted: The send was routed to the current integration.
validation.exemption_required: A 0% VAT rate needs an exemption code and reason.
validation.identity_number: A tax number has 10 digits, a national ID 11.
validation.vat_rate: The VAT rate is between 0 and 100.
settings.title: Invoice settings
settings.description: Series, supplier address, default note, taxpayer cache and the VAT mapping per line kind.
settings.load_failed: Invoice settings could not be loaded.
settings.connection_hint.none: No e-invoice integration. Invoices are finalized but sending waits until one is connected.
settings.connection_hint.waiting: Waiting on the official integrator (TEC-685). Sends start on their own once it is ready.
settings.connection_hint.test: A test integrator is connected: documents do not reach GİB for real.
settings.connection_hint.unavailable: The integrator is unavailable; sends are on hold.
settings.missing_hint: Legal name, tax number and tax office come from the company settings; district, city and postal code from the form below.
settings.series_hint: Three capital letters or digits (e.g. RNT). e-Invoice and e-Archive use different series.
settings.cache_hint: A taxpayer lookup is reused for this long (1–720 hours).
settings.mappings_hint: VAT rate and, if needed, exemption per line kind. Kinds you do not change use the Turkish default (20%).
settings.mapping_description: New drafts use this rate; existing invoices do not change.
settings.exemption_hint: GİB exemption code; required for a 0% rate.
settings.validation.cache_hours: Enter a whole number between 1 and 720.
settings.validation.vat_rate: The VAT rate is between 0 and 100.
settings.validation.exemption_required: A 0% VAT rate needs an exemption code and reason.
